Per-File Incremental Cloud Sync (MEGA / Google Drive / OneDrive / WebDAV)

          

            Unlike VeraCrypt fixed-size containers, CipherVault-X encrypts each file into independent .c9r ciphertext files. Adding or editing a 50 KB file only uploads that 50 KB .c9r delta when you close the vault.
